description: Install a CI-triggered LLM code reviewer into the current repo: on every push to a PR/MR, Claude Code runs headless, reproduces every claim the change makes, hunts correctness bugs with concrete failure scenarios, and posts a machine-readable execution verdict. For configured bot branches (do/* by default), it also requires a separate value verdict before auto-merge, rejecting bookkeeping-only work and incomplete outcomes. Detects GitHub vs GitLab, installs a deterministic verdict gate, and supports review-only or auto-merge tiers. Use when the user says /ci-review, 装一个 CI 代码审查, CI 里自动 code review, 给 PR/MR 加 AI review, 让机器人验证 PR, 审查通过自动合并.
